description:
**Innerve 11** stands as **India’s Largest Student-Driven Hackathon**, proudly organized by the AIT Open Source Software Club at the prestigious **Army Institute of Technology (AIT), Pune**. This flagship innovation festival is dedicated to fueling creativity, empowering problem-solving, and fostering collaboration among the brightest student innovators across the country — all with **zero registration fees** to ensure open participation.

> **Event Stages**

**24-Hour Grand Finale Hackathon**  
January 29–30, 2027

Participants will pitch their ideas, refine them with mentor support, and battle it out in the intense 24-hour finale to build impactful, real-world solutions.

> **Prize Pool**

Innerve 11 boasts an extraordinary **₹12,00,000+ prize pool**, offering:

- Cash prizes for the top-performing teams
- Premium merchandise and exclusive Innerve goodies
- Special sponsor-provided benefits, credits, and services
- Additional cash rewards for solving **Custom Sponsor Problem Statements**, worth up to **₹15,000 each**

> **Themes & Challenges**

This edition features **nine exciting themes**, including two newly introduced domains, empowering participants to innovate across multiple fronts:

- Web3 & Blockchain
- Defence Systems
- Healthcare
- FinTech
- Cybersecurity
- EduTech
- Game Development
- AR/VR
- Logistics

Participants may also explore **Open Innovation**, submitting any hardware or software solution that pushes boundaries.

> **What Participants Get**

**Free Food**  
Complimentary meals provided to all hackathon finalists.

**Zero Registration Fee**  
Completely free for all participants, ensuring accessibility and inclusivity.

**Real-World Exposure**  
Solve industry-backed challenges from leading sponsors and gain hands-on experience building practical solutions.

> **Prizes & Rewards**

**Winner — ₹1,25,000**  
Crowned the ultimate innovator team with unmatched opportunities!

**First Runner-Up — ₹75,000**  
Rising tech stars stealing the spotlight!

**Second Runner-Up — ₹50,000**  
Recognized for outstanding tech excellence!
  
**Custom PS Winners — ₹15,000**  
Special prizes for solving sponsor-introduced custom problem statements!

For any queries, contact us at **innerve@aitpune.edu.in** or call **+91 95094 40704**.

**Sample PPT**  
Link: https://tinyurl.com/4y7s76zj

hackathon_faqs.answer: Sessions with the top experts in their fields, a 24-hour hackathon with incredible problems, and rewards! **Swags and Goodies.**
hackathon_faqs.question: What are the perks of attending Innerve 11 ?

hackathon_faqs.answer: You are indeed free to collaborate with the group of people you like. The size of your team might also range from **2 to 4.**
hackathon_faqs.question: Can the team members be from different colleges?

hackathon_faqs.answer: No, there is **no registration fees** to attend Innerve 11.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is there any registration fees to attend Innerve 11 ?

hackathon_faqs.answer: The Phase I of the Innerve 11 (**Idea submission round**) is online and Phase II (**Hackathon round**) is offline that will be conducted in AIT Campus.
hackathon_faqs.question: Is this hackathon online or offline?

hackathon_faqs.answer: You love to code, you are more than welcome to participate in the Hackathon.
hackathon_faqs.question: Any specific qualifications to be a participant in the Hackathon?

hackathon_faqs.answer: Prior work and pre-made projects are not allowed at Innerve. All work should be done in the duration of the hackathon.
hackathon_faqs.question: Are pre-made projects allowed?
